context_diary: The account_lookup function allows querying users by type (USER, AGENT, ADMIN) with configurable return fields. The platform maintains a single system-level admin account (ID: 1) created at initialization. System accounts are flagged with is_system_account: true. Query patterns support filtering by status and pagination via limit parameter.
